research_question: For each repository separately, what descriptive locked-benchmark signal does the exact candidate Skill revision produce relative to the exact baseline after repairing the measurement and evidence contracts?
claims_scope: Descriptive evidence for the exact Skill revisions, authored 24-task benchmark, Claude Code harness, Anthropic Sonnet 5 route, and locked local Harbor runtime only. These Studies do not estimate a community task population and are not conference-claim eligible.

claim_eligibility.reason: The repaired Studies retain sixteen authored holdout tasks per repository, lack a population sampling frame, and are far below the prospective independent-task requirement.
claim_eligibility.allowed_claim: A task- and revision-specific descriptive locked-benchmark finding with exact effect estimates, intervals, adjusted p-values, and limitations.

diagnostic_no_skill_contrast.reason: The governed ComparisonSpecV1 contract is two-arm. A generic three-arm run would not preserve comparison approval and result contracts.
diagnostic_no_skill_contrast.claim_limitation: Prompt-ceiling and absolute Skill benefit cannot be estimated without a separately governed no-Skill contrast.

prospective_power_design.claim_effect: The repaired 16-holdout Studies remain descriptive measurement development. Population or conference-qualified behavioral claims require sealed sampling frames and separately approved adequately powered Studies.

budget_policy.claim_effect: These finite limits govern only the three exact descriptive V2 campaign Studies. The policy authorizes no model call, preview approval, conference claim, powered holdout, or campaign-wide spend.

randomization.arm_order: deterministically counterbalanced from the immutable attempt identity

endpoints.primary: Task-level mean of the preregistered outcome dimensions, with safety gates reported separately and verified by the host outside the Agent workspace.
endpoints.mechanism_role: assignment, opening, and invocation evidence; never a task-outcome pass
endpoints.safety_role: zero-tolerance descriptive gate reported separately from the outcome estimand

analysis.interval: deterministic task-cluster bootstrap with the repository-profile resample count
analysis.paired_test: two-sided exact sign test over nonzero task-level differences
analysis.claim_interpretation: All p-values and intervals are descriptive for the authored locked benchmark because the sampling frame and prospective power requirements are unmet.

missingness.rerun_policy: Only the exact interrupted or infrastructure-failed attempt may resume under the locked retry contract; no outcome-dependent retry is permitted.

release_gates: Exact public task, private label, scorer, Skill, model, runtime, protocol, and power-design locks
All planned terminal cells reconcile uniquely to canonical rows
All five evidence links resolve in the declared W&B project
No private-label or credential value appears in Agent-visible evidence
No duplicate attempts or run-scoped Harbor orphans
Manual trace audit is complete and signed
Every limitation and missing row is reported
No descriptive Study is presented as population- or conference-qualified
